subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 05, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - November 05, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

We are excited to share with you the latest updates from the AcreetionOS project. Our community has been actively contributing to the development of our sovereign Arch Linux distribution, and we are grateful for their efforts.

In the past week, several important updates have been made to the project. The geocode-glib update conflict has been fixed, ensuring that our users can continue to use our distribution without any issues. Additionally, we have released a new version of Bazzite, a popular image editor, and issued security updates for various packages.

Our community has also been busy with new commits and contributions. Cobra3282000 has made significant progress on the firefox-fix package, restoring the window position restore on Linux. Natalie has also been working on the acreetion-surf project, releasing version 2.0.0. Meanwhile, cobra3282000 has made commits to the calamares-config-wayland and lmm-ai projects, improving the Wayland session and installing lightdm-slick-greeter to fix displaymanager job crashes.

We would like to extend our gratitude to all the contributors who have made these updates possible. Your hard work and dedication to the project are truly appreciated. As always, we encourage everyone to participate in the development process and contribute to the project in any way they can.

If you are interested in getting involved, please join our Discord server and start a conversation with us. We are always looking for new contributors and are happy to guide you through the process.

In other news, our GitLab instance has been updated with new features and improvements. You can now view the activity calendar and personal projects of our members, including Natalie and Darren.

We would like to remind everyone that our community is built on the principles of sovereignty, transparency, and collaboration. We believe that everyone should have control over their own data and software, and we strive to create a distribution that reflects these values.

As always, we are committed to providing a secure and private Linux distribution that meets the needs of our users. We will continue to work tirelessly to ensure that our distribution remains free from telemetry and other unwanted features.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We look forward to seeing what the future holds for our project and are excited to have you along for the ride.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva and Darren Clift, Co-Lead Developers of AcreetionOS
